title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats

paragraphs.en: We’re introducing a new life sciences research group and laboratory at Anthropic. Our focus is on fundamental biology research using Claude: exploring datasets of DNA to identify uncharacterized protein families, generating hypotheses at scale, and testing them through experiments in the lab. This post introduces the team behind this work and shares early results in which Claude discovered a novel enzyme system with properties reminiscent of CRISPR, with only high-level direction from our scientists. Many discoveries that have revolutionized biology and medicine started with a scientist noticing something odd in the staggering diversity of molecular machines found in nature. Restriction enzymes , proteins that cut DNA at specific short sequences , were found in bacterial immune systems, where they destroy the DNA of invading viruses. Researchers realized they could use these enzymes to cut DNA at chosen places and splice genes from one organism into another, which launched the biotechnology industry. Taq polymerase, an enzyme that copies DNA at high temperatures, was identified in a bacterium in a Yellowstone hot spring. It became the basis for PCR, the DNA-copying method used in much of modern diagnostics. CRISPR was first noticed as an unusual repeat sequence in the DNA of certain bacteria, and is now the foundation of gene editing-based medicines. In the spring of 2026, we formed a research group to see whether general AI models can systematize and accelerate such discoveries . We believe that this acceleration will come from establishing a new way of doing biology research, in which agents collaborate with humans in every step of the process. Developing this new way of working required that we build our own lab and a single team working on everything from training Claude in biology to running experiments in the lab.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将在 Anthropic 成立一个新的生命科学研究组和实验室。 我们的重点是使用 Claude 开展基础生物学研究：探索 DNA 数据集以识别未被表征的蛋白质家族，大规模生成假设，并通过实验室实验加以验证。 这篇文章介绍了这项工作背后的团队，并分享了早期成果：在科学家仅给予高层指导的情况下，Claude 发现了一种性质上与 CRISPR 相似的新型酶系统。 许多彻底改变生物学和医学的发现，都始于科学家在自然界中种类惊人的分子机器中注意到某些异常之处。 限制性内切酶——能在特定短序列处切割 DNA 的蛋白质——被发现于细菌的免疫系统中，它们在其中破坏入侵病毒的 DNA。 研究人员意识到，可以利用这些酶在选定的位置切割 DNA，并把基因从一个生物体拼接进另一个生物体，由此催生了生物技术产业。 Taq 聚合酶是一种能在高温下复制 DNA 的酶，它在黄石公园一处温泉的细菌中被发现。 它成为了 PCR（一种 DNA 复制方法，被广泛应用于现代诊断）的基础。 CRISPR 最初是被注意到的某些细菌 DNA 中一种异常的重复序列，如今已成为基于基因编辑的药物的基础。 2026 年春，我们成立了一个研究组，以探究通用 AI 模型能否使此类发现系统化并加以加速。 我们相信，这种加速将来自一种全新生物学研究方式的建立——在这个过程中，智能体与人类协作完成每一步。 要建立这种新的工作方式，我们需要打造自己的实验室和一个单一的团队，负责从在生物学领域训练 Claude 到在实验室开展实验的一切工作。

sents.zh: 要建立这种新的工作方式，我们需要打造自己的实验室和一个单一的团队，负责从在生物学领域训练 Claude 到在实验室开展实验的一切工作。

paragraphs.en: Today, we’re sharing early results from one of our first research programs, in which Claude autonomously discovered a novel enzyme system that is associated with an array of DNA repeats, a pattern reminiscent of CRISPR. Although we don’t yet know its function, the system that Claude discovered has a set of characteristics that have only ever been found together in a handful of other systems, all of which are programmable and perform operations like cutting, copying, and pasting DNA. Beyond CRISPR, which has already transformed science and medicine, several other such systems are now in development as promising tools.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，我们将分享我们首批研究项目之一的早期成果，其中Claude自主发现了一种新型酶系统，该系统与一系列DNA重复序列相关，这一模式令人联想到CRISPR。 尽管我们尚不清楚其功能，但Claude发现的这一系统具有一组迄今仅在少数其他系统中同时出现的特征，而那些系统都是可编程的，能够执行诸如切割、复制和粘贴DNA等操作。 除了已经变革了科学与医学的CRISPR之外，目前还有其他几个此类系统正在开发中，前景可观，有望成为工具。

paragraphs.en: The system that Claude found is based on a reverse transcriptase (RT), enzymes that copy RNA into DNA. While this underlying RT, found in a jumbo phage, had been identified in previous studies, Claude appears to be the first to notice the system’s defining features—an associated array of non-coding DNA sequences and an additional accessory protein of unknown function.
paragraphs.zh: Claude发现的这一系统基于一种逆转录酶（RT），即把RNA复制成DNA的酶。 虽然这个底层RT是在一种巨型噬菌体中发现的，并且在以往的研究中已被鉴定出来，但Claude似乎是最先注意到该系统标志性特征的人——一组相关的非编码DNA序列，以及一个功能未知的附加辅助蛋白。

sents.zh: Claude发现的这一系统基于一种逆转录酶（RT），即把RNA复制成DNA的酶。

sents.en: While this underlying RT, found in a jumbo phage, had been identified in previous studies, Claude appears to be the first to notice the system’s defining features—an associated array of non-coding DNA sequences and an additional accessory protein of unknown function.

paragraphs.en: After reviewing the pre-print, Feng Zhang, one of the pioneers of CRISPR genome editing and a professor at MIT and the Broad Institute, said:
paragraphs.zh: 在审阅了这篇预印本后，CRISPR 基因组编辑领域的先驱之一、麻省理工学院和布罗德研究所教授张锋表示：

paragraphs.en: We gave Claude a prompt to search through a massive database of DNA sequences for interesting new examples of RTs. Our involvement was limited to the initial prompt and the lab work, while Claude agents combed through the database, investigated the distinct RT families, and used their own judgment to identify interesting candidates. After 21 hours spent searching this data by roughly 950 agents using 210 million tokens, one of the agents spotted something remarkable: a repeating pattern of DNA sequences that occurs next to the gene for an odd-looking RT. After further analysis and testing in our lab, we recognized that this pattern marked a previously uncharacterized enzyme system found in bacteriophages (the viruses that infect bacteria) that we call array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART).
paragraphs.zh: 我们给Claude提供了一个提示，让它在庞大的DNA序列数据库中搜索有趣的新型逆转录酶（RT）实例。 我们的参与仅限于初始提示和实验室工作，而Claude智能体则梳理数据库、研究不同的RT家族，并运用自己的判断来识别有价值的候选对象。 在大约950个智能体使用2.1亿个token对数据进行了21小时的搜索后，其中一个智能体发现了一项了不起的东西：一种重复出现的DNA序列模式，位于一个外观奇特的RT基因旁边。 经过进一步分析和我们实验室的测试，我们确认这种模式标记了一个在噬菌体（感染细菌的病毒）中发现的、此前未被表征的酶系统，我们将其命名为阵列相关逆转录酶（ART）。

sents.zh: 我们给Claude提供了一个提示，让它在庞大的DNA序列数据库中搜索有趣的新型逆转录酶（RT）实例。

sents.en: After further analysis and testing in our lab, we recognized that this pattern marked a previously uncharacterized enzyme system found in bacteriophages (the viruses that infect bacteria) that we call array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART).
sents.zh: 经过进一步分析和我们实验室的测试，我们确认这种模式标记了一个在噬菌体（感染细菌的病毒）中发现的、此前未被表征的酶系统，我们将其命名为阵列相关逆转录酶（ART）。

paragraphs.en: Our work to understand the primary function of ARTs is ongoing. However, we think it is important to share such findings early, both to demonstrate Claude’s capabilities and to give the broader community insight into what we’re working on. We have released a pre-print ( here ) that discusses this in more detail.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对理解 ARTs 主要功能的工作仍在进行中。 然而，我们认为尽早分享这类发现非常重要，这既能展示 Claude 的能力，也能让更广泛的社区了解我们正在进行的工作。 我们已发布一篇预印本文章（见此处），其中对此进行了更详细的讨论。

paragraphs.en: We are a team of scientists who have spent our careers exploring unusual proteins, and specialize in using computational approaches to systematically read DNA, interpret its evolution, and pick out biological systems for further characterization. Our research prior to joining Anthropic has helped to better understand the evolution and regulation of CRISPR systems, discover new enzymes for next-generation cell and gene therapies , and build tools for accelerating the identification of anomalies in DNA, such as human pathogenic variants. We are part of Anthropic’s life sciences organization, alongside teams whose work includes drug discovery, and training Claude in biology and chemistry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们是一支由科学家组成的团队，职业生涯一直致力于探索不寻常的蛋白质，擅长运用计算方法系统地读取DNA、解读其演化，并挑选出值得进一步表征的生物系统。 在加入Anthropic之前，我们的研究工作已经帮助人们更好地理解CRISPR系统的演化与调控，发现了用于下一代细胞和基因疗法的新酶，并构建了加速识别DNA异常（例如人类致病变异）的工具。 我们隶属于Anthropic的生命科学组织，与之并肩的团队工作包括药物发现，以及在生物学和化学领域对Claude进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Our lab, located in the Bay Area, looks like a typical molecular biology lab. We do research that involves only the lower levels of the biosafety risk level (BSL-1 and BSL-2) and we do not handle pathogens that can infect humans. All of the lab work is performed by human scientists. Although we’ve experimented with using AI to accelerate lab work with initiatives like the Model Hardware Standard , this approach is less conducive to the sort of ad hoc workflows that are involved in our molecular biology research.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验室位于湾区，看起来是一个典型的分子生物学实验室。 我们的研究仅涉及较低等级的生物安全风险级别（BSL-1 和 BSL-2），我们不处理能够感染人类的病原体。 所有实验室工作均由人类科学家完成。 尽管我们曾尝试通过「模型硬件标准」等举措利用 AI 来加速实验室工作，但这种方法不太适合我们分子生物学研究中常见的临时性工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Many of our workflows involve having Claude search through the vast collection of DNA sequences associated with proteins without a known function. One typical pattern begins with a survey of a given protein family. Claude reads the relevant literature and reproduces the established results from public data to check its methods. It then searches for family members or genomic neighbors that fit no described system, and writes a short, human-readable report for each candidate that proposes a function and describes the evidence supporting its claims. In follow-up analyses, Claude critically evaluates the evidence—typically most candidates are eliminated at this stage. A survey may end with a single candidate worth testing, or with none.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的许多工作流程都需要让 Claude 在与功能未知的蛋白质相关的大量 DNA 序列集合中进行检索。 一种典型的模式首先是对给定的蛋白质家族进行调研。 Claude 会阅读相关文献，并根据公开数据复现已确立的结果，以检验其方法。 随后，它会搜索不符合任何已描述系统的家族成员或基因组邻近序列，并为每个候选序列撰写一份简短、易于人类阅读的报告，提出一种功能假设并描述支持其论断的证据。 在后续分析中，Claude 会对证据进行批判性评估——通常大多数候选序列在这一阶段会被淘汰。 一次调研最终可能留下一个值得检验的候选序列，也可能一无所获。

paragraphs.en: When a candidate survives our review, we test it in the laboratory, expressing the protein in standard laboratory strains and characterizing it biochemically and structurally, with Claude helping to interpret the data. We do our work in Claude Science and Claude Code , the same tools available to any scientist, and sometimes with a harness of our own that coordinates many Claude sessions running in parallel.
paragraphs.zh: 当候选方案通过我们的评审后，我们会在实验室中进行测试，在标准实验室菌株中表达该蛋白质，并从生化和结构层面对其进行表征，由 Claude 协助解读数据。 我们的工作在 Claude Science 和 Claude Code 中完成，这些工具与任何科学家可用的工具相同，有时也会使用我们自己搭建的框架来协调许多并行运行的 Claude 会话。

sents.zh: 当候选方案通过我们的评审后，我们会在实验室中进行测试，在标准实验室菌株中表达该蛋白质，并从生化和结构层面对其进行表征，由 Claude 协助解读数据。

sents.en: We do our work in Claude Science and Claude Code , the same tools available to any scientist, and sometimes with a harness of our own that coordinates many Claude sessions running in parallel.
sents.zh: 我们的工作在 Claude Science 和 Claude Code 中完成，这些工具与任何科学家可用的工具相同，有时也会使用我们自己搭建的框架来协调许多并行运行的 Claude 会话。

paragraphs.en: Because Claude produces hypotheses so prolifically, the hypotheses themselves have become an object of study for us. With hundreds to thousands of candidate reports from a single campaign, we have been asking what distinguishes the proposals we judge worth testing from those we set aside. What we learn goes back into the instructions we give Claude and teaches it to mimic our own scientific taste.
paragraphs.zh: 由于 Claude 高产地产出假设，这些假设本身已成为我们的研究对象。 面对单次任务产生的成百上千份候选报告，我们一直在思考：是什么使我们判定值得检验的提案区别于那些被搁置的提案。 我们学到的东西会回灌到给 Claude 的指令中，教它模仿我们自己的科学品味。

sents.zh: 由于 Claude 高产地产出假设，这些假设本身已成为我们的研究对象。

sents.zh: 我们学到的东西会回灌到给 Claude 的指令中，教它模仿我们自己的科学品味。

paragraphs.en: In the past few years, researchers have discovered many more reverse transcriptases (RTs), most of them in bacteria, where they act as part of the immune system. Nearly all RT families were found by genomic analysis, or genome mining, which requires researchers to search sequence databases for genes that no one has characterized, notice the unusual ones, and work out what they do.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去几年中，研究人员发现了更多逆转录酶（RT），其中大多数存在于细菌中，在细菌中它们作为免疫系统的一部分发挥作用。 几乎所有 RT 家族都是通过基因组分析（即基因组挖掘）发现的，这要求研究人员在序列数据库中搜索尚未被表征的基因，留意其中不寻常者，并弄清它们的功能。

sents.en: In the past few years, researchers have discovered many more reverse transcriptases (RTs), most of them in bacteria, where they act as part of the immune system.
sents.zh: 在过去几年中，研究人员发现了更多逆转录酶（RT），其中大多数存在于细菌中，在细菌中它们作为免疫系统的一部分发挥作用。

sents.en: Nearly all RT families were found by genomic analysis, or genome mining, which requires researchers to search sequence databases for genes that no one has characterized, notice the unusual ones, and work out what they do.
sents.zh: 几乎所有 RT 家族都是通过基因组分析（即基因组挖掘）发现的，这要求研究人员在序列数据库中搜索尚未被表征的基因，留意其中不寻常者，并弄清它们的功能。

paragraphs.en: Claude agents gathered over 200,000 RTs, picked out 3,500 new candidate systems, and narrowed those to the 20 most compelling candidates that they analyzed to produce human-readable reports. For an expert scientist, this type of analysis can take weeks to months of work.
paragraphs.zh: Claude 智能体收集了超过 200,000 条 RT，筛选出 3,500 个新的候选系统，并将其缩小到 20 个最具说服力的候选系统，随后对它们进行分析以生成人类可读的报告。 对于一位专业科学家来说，这类分析可能需要数周到数月的工作。

sents.en: Claude agents gathered over 200,000 RTs, picked out 3,500 new candidate systems, and narrowed those to the 20 most compelling candidates that they analyzed to produce human-readable reports.
sents.zh: Claude 智能体收集了超过 200,000 条 RT，筛选出 3,500 个新的候选系统，并将其缩小到 20 个最具说服力的候选系统，随后对它们进行分析以生成人类可读的报告。

sents.en: For an expert scientist, this type of analysis can take weeks to months of work.
sents.zh: 对于一位专业科学家来说，这类分析可能需要数周到数月的工作。

paragraphs.en: During the course of its research, Claude noticed an unusual RT family and decided to examine it in greater detail. While combing through the raw DNA sequence near the RT, the agent exclaimed: “[The DNA next to the RT] is spectacular: I can see by eye a tandem repeat array … that's a CRISPR-like … repeat array?!”
paragraphs.zh: 在研究过程中，Claude 注意到一个不寻常的 RT 家族，并决定对其进行更深入的考察。 在梳理 RT 附近的原始 DNA 序列时，该智能体惊叹道：「[RT 旁边的 DNA] 非常惊人：我肉眼就能看出一个串联重复序列阵列……那是一个类似 CRISPR 的……重复序列阵列？！」

sents.en: During the course of its research, Claude noticed an unusual RT family and decided to examine it in greater detail.
sents.zh: 在研究过程中，Claude 注意到一个不寻常的 RT 家族，并决定对其进行更深入的考察。

sents.en: While combing through the raw DNA sequence near the RT, the agent exclaimed: “[The DNA next to the RT] is spectacular: I can see by eye a tandem repeat array … that's a CRISPR-like … repeat array?!”
sents.zh: 在梳理 RT 附近的原始 DNA 序列时，该智能体惊叹道：「[RT 旁边的 DNA] 非常惊人：我肉眼就能看出一个串联重复序列阵列……那是一个类似 CRISPR 的……重复序列阵列？！」

paragraphs.en: It then proceeded much as a human scientist would when faced with a potential discovery. It counted the repeats and measured their spacing, compared the layout with the known RT systems, and searched the literature for any previous report of the pattern. After a thorough analysis it was convinced that it had found a new biological system, and filed a report for human review.
paragraphs.zh: 随后它的做法与人类科学家面对一个潜在发现时的流程十分相似。 它统计了重复序列的数量并测量其间距，将这种排布与已知的 RT 系统进行比较，并检索文献中是否有关于该模式的先前报告。 经过全面分析后，它确信自己发现了一个新的生物系统，并撰写了一份报告提交给人类审阅。

sents.en: It then proceeded much as a human scientist would when faced with a potential discovery.
sents.zh: 随后它的做法与人类科学家面对一个潜在发现时的流程十分相似。

sents.en: It counted the repeats and measured their spacing, compared the layout with the known RT systems, and searched the literature for any previous report of the pattern.
sents.zh: 它统计了重复序列的数量并测量其间距，将这种排布与已知的 RT 系统进行比较，并检索文献中是否有关于该模式的先前报告。

sents.en: After a thorough analysis it was convinced that it had found a new biological system, and filed a report for human review.
sents.zh: 经过全面分析后，它确信自己发现了一个新的生物系统，并撰写了一份报告提交给人类审阅。

paragraphs.en: The system it found, ART, is found mainly in bacteriophages and consists of three parts: the RT, a partner gene beside it, and a long array of evenly spaced DNA repeat sequences. The repeat layout resembles a CRISPR array, which holds a bank of different RNA sequences that make CRISPR-Cas systems programmable biotechnological tools. Our first experiments show that the ART array is also expressed as a set of distinct short RNAs, suggesting that something analogous may be at play for this system.
paragraphs.zh: 它发现的这个系统是ART，主要存在于噬菌体中，由三部分组成：逆转录酶（RT）、其旁边的伴基因，以及一长串间距均匀的DNA重复序列。 这种重复序列的排布类似于CRISPR阵列，CRISPR阵列储存着多种不同的RNA序列，正是这些序列使CRISPR-Cas系统成为可编程的生物技术工具。 我们的初步实验表明，ART阵列同样会被表达为一组不同的短RNA，这提示类似的机制可能也在这个系统中发挥作用。

sents.en: The system it found, ART, is found mainly in bacteriophages and consists of three parts: the RT, a partner gene beside it, and a long array of evenly spaced DNA repeat sequences.
sents.zh: 它发现的这个系统是ART，主要存在于噬菌体中，由三部分组成：逆转录酶（RT）、其旁边的伴基因，以及一长串间距均匀的DNA重复序列。

sents.en: The repeat layout resembles a CRISPR array, which holds a bank of different RNA sequences that make CRISPR-Cas systems programmable biotechnological tools.
sents.zh: 这种重复序列的排布类似于CRISPR阵列，CRISPR阵列储存着多种不同的RNA序列，正是这些序列使CRISPR-Cas系统成为可编程的生物技术工具。

sents.en: Our first experiments show that the ART array is also expressed as a set of distinct short RNAs, suggesting that something analogous may be at play for this system.
sents.zh: 我们的初步实验表明，ART阵列同样会被表达为一组不同的短RNA，这提示类似的机制可能也在这个系统中发挥作用。

paragraphs.en: Further experiments are underway to determine how ART works, and we are sharing these early findings to show the community that Claude can autonomously detect anomalies and drive analyses to initiate biological discoveries.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步的实验正在进行中，以确定 ART 的工作原理，我们分享这些早期发现，是为了向社区展示 Claude 能够自主检测异常并推动分析以启动生物学发现。

paragraphs.en: You can find more detail in our technical report ( here ).
paragraphs.zh: 你可以在我们的技术报告（这里）中找到更多详细信息。
